business_problem: Hitachi Vantara wanted to scale high-value AI use cases securely while replacing manual HR and procurement workflows that were still driven by legacy tools and email.
solution_summary: Hitachi Vantara wanted to scale high-value AI use cases securely while replacing manual HR and procurement workflows that were still driven by legacy tools and email. Hitachi Vantara implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, and App Engine. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; HR Service Delivery manages HR cases and onboarding; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; App Engine builds custom workflow apps. The stack also connected SharePoint so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, and uses context from SharePoint before ServiceNow AI Platform, HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, and App Engine routes or fulfills the work.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: HR Service Delivery
solution_components.role: Moves HR cases, onboarding, and employee support workflows onto the same platform.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Standardizes incident, request, and fulfillment workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: App Engine
solution_components.role: Supports custom workflow and application development for business processes.

solution_components.name: SharePoint
solution_components.role: Supplies enterprise documents and knowledge content used by AI assistants and self-service.
